sections.heading: Care, briefly
sections.html: Everything is pre-washed, machine quilted, and labeled, and it can all go in the machine again: cold water, gentle cycle, dry flat for the runners. Stock changes weekly, and restocks are announced at the market booth first.

sections.title: Market dates
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Where the booth lands this season, with hours, parking, and what is new on the table.

sections.heading: At the booth
sections.html: There is a card reader, a hold list for end-of-day bargains, and a mending corner: bring a quilt from the closet with a wobbly binding and I will quote the repair while you shop. Special orders taken at markets start the custom queue with the online requests.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: One sewist, a dining-room studio, and a habit of finishing quilts faster than one household can use them.

sections.heading: How this started
sections.html:
The first market was an accident: a winter of sewing for a new niece and nephew left a stack of baby quilts that one household could not absorb, so a neighbor rented me half a table at the school craft fair. The stack sold out by eleven, and the permission to make more was the real purchase.

Everything is still sewn at home, one at a time, with the day job on weekdays and production runs on Sundays. Nothing here was made in a factory, and it shows in the small wobbles, which we call signature seams.

items.quote: The crib quilt survived two kids, one dog, and ninety washes. I came back and bought the next size up.
items.author: A market regular

sections.title: Custom orders
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Two custom slots a month: crib quilts in nursery colors, runners cut to your table, throws to fit a reading chair.

sections.heading: Lead times and deposits
sections.html: Custom pieces take three to five weeks from fabric approval. Half down books the slot, the balance is due at pickup or shipping, and photos of the cut fabrics go out before any sewing so there are no surprises but the good kind.
